calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Surpreme Opti
calls.summary: Jake Heier from GrowthBook demonstrated the platform to Tenea Welsh and Fabrizio Michels of Supreme Optimization, an agency seeking A/B testing for client websites. They discussed GA4 integration via BigQuery, conversion tracking limitations, and the challenge of targeting thousands of unique product URLs, with solutions including saved groups and CSV uploads.
